_note: hand-authored 1944 V-weapon dataset (no third-party licence); generated by tools/make_v_weapons_1940.py. Site identities follow the wartime Operation Crossbow / No-Ball record (the RAF reconnaissance of the ski-shaped buildings, the Reseau AGIR reports and the Wikipedia article 'V-1 flying bomb facilities'); the ski-site / depot localities are real WGS84 coordinates verified against OpenStreetMap (Nominatim, ODbL). The two Heavy Cross bunkers at Wizernes and Eperlecques carry the exact Wikipedia coordinates. No third-party geometry or imagery was copied.
